name: Savannakhet Digital Government Center
developer: Ministry of Technology and Communications / Savannakhet Technology and Communications Division
notes: ESCAP report states MTC established a similar Digital Government Center in the Technology and Communications Division in Savannakhet Province in 2021, serving its 14 districts; local report citation dated 2023-03-22. Government digital services/cloud support center, not a commercial hyperscale/colo facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: Lao Data Center (LaoDC)
developer: Lao DC IT Sole Co. Ltd.
notes: Company site says LaoDC operates its own data center in Vientiane Capital with colocation, dedicated/virtual servers, redundant fiber rings, redundant power, emergency diesel generators, and a solar plant. Assigned to Viangchan because the batch uses the Viangchan/Vientiane division label.

name: LEED Datacenter / Ministry of Technology and Communications Digital Data Center
developer: Ministry of Technology and Communications; Global Digital Management Solutions (GDMS)
notes: GDMS announced a renewed 10-year partnership with MTC for developing, maintaining, managing and upgrading the LEED digital data center in Vientiane; Vientiane Times reports GDMS launched cloud infrastructure using the JICA-built LEED datacenter and hosts e-government platforms.

name: Ready to Connect (R2C) Tier 3 Data Center
notes: R2C describes its Data Center as Tier 3 with dual-powered equipment, multiple uplinks and support for cloud/colocation/dedicated servers; contact page lists Ready To Connect (Laos) in Vientiane Capital. JICA survey also identifies R2C as one of the major data centers in Lao PDR.

name: Datacom Data Center Services
notes: Datacom's official site lists Vientiane office addresses and offers data center services including colocation hosting, DR site, VPS and email hosting. Physical facility details and capacity are not disclosed.

name: Green AI Data Center / AI Innovation Centre Pilot and AI SEZ
developer: National Data Center under the Ministry of Technology and Communications; Silicon Tech Park (Lao) Sole Co., Ltd.
notes: Vientiane Times reports an MoU for a feasibility study on green-energy AI infrastructure, including an AI Innovation Centre pilot and a more than 150-hectare AI SEZ in the capital area of Vientiane; article refers to the initiative as a Green AI Data Center project. Capacity and final approval not disclosed.

name: Xaisomboun Digital Government Center
developer: Ministry of Technology and Communications / Technology and Communications Division in Xaysomboun Province
notes: ESCAP report states MTC established the Digital Government Centre within the Technology and Communications Division in Xaysomboun Province between 2015 and 2017, supporting provincial government offices with e-office, G-Chat, G-Share, G-web and cloud computing systems; local MPT report citation dated 2018-08-09. Capacity not disclosed.
